start: Two replies arrived on two questions; Android; notifications allowed

steps.action: Bring the app to the front
user_sees: One pop-up: '2 new replies. Tap to read the answer.'
must_not: Two pop-ups stacked in the shade

steps.action: Same on an iPhone
user_sees: No pop-up; the red dot with '2' on the round tab
must_not: A crash
A permission ask

start: Android; MettleUp notifications turned off; a reply arrived

steps.action: Bring the app to the front
user_sees: No pop-up
The red dot with the number on the round tab
must_not: The app asking for notification permission
A crash

steps.action: Leave and come back again within one minute
user_sees: Nothing new
must_not: A new ask to the server on every return (once a minute at most)

start: Android; a reply already popped up once

steps.action: Swipe the pop-up away, bring the app to the front again
user_sees: No second pop-up for that reply
must_not: The same reply popped up twice

steps.action: Read it in Help and feedback; a new reply comes later; bring the app to the front
user_sees: A pop-up for the new reply only
must_not: No pop-up for the new reply
'2 new replies' counting the read one

start: Android phone locked with notifications on the lock screen

steps.action: A reply arrives and the app checks
user_sees: Only 'The MettleUp team answered your question' and 'Tap to read the answer.'
must_not: The question or the reply text on the lock screen

start: Android phone, MettleUp notifications allowed, a question sent 3 days ago, app in the background; set-up: old saved data in the new version

steps.action: With Feedback message, help question saved by the old version, update the app, then do "Notification 'The MettleUp team answered your question'".
user_sees: The old Feedback message, help question shown in full, with the same values as before the update
must_not: Old Feedback message, help question missing, shown with empty or wrong fields, or changed without the user doing anything

steps.action: The MettleUp team replies; the member opens the app (or it comes back to the front)
user_sees: Pop-up 'The MettleUp team answered your question' with 'Tap to read the answer.'
must_not: A second pop-up for a first reply HQ already pushed
A pop-up for a reply already read

steps.action: Tap the pop-up
user_sees: Profile → Settings → Help and feedback opens; the reply marked 'New'
must_not: The app opening on another tab
A sound over a running workout
Old Feedback message, help question missing, shown with empty or wrong fields, or changed without the user doing anything

note: Questions kept before R-452 have no 'told' time; it falls back to the last reply so old replies do not pop up

steps.action: Close the app (swipe it away) at step 1 of "Notification 'The MettleUp team answered your question'", then open it again.
user_sees: Either nothing was saved, or the Feedback message, help question is whole; the app says which
must_not: A half-saved Feedback message, help question, a double Feedback message, help question after trying again, or a stuck screen on reopening

note: Replies are asked for only when the app opens or comes back; a closed app relies on HQ's push
